import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Income distribution by education level
income_edu_data = df[['Education', 'Income']].dropna()
order = income_edu_data['Education'].value_counts().index
sns.boxplot(data=income_edu_data, x='Education', y='Income', order=order, ax=axes[0, 0])
axes[0, 0].set_title('Income Distribution by Education Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Education Level', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Income ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Spending patterns across product categories
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 
                 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_data = df[spending_cols].sum()
spending_data.index = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(spending_data)))
axes[0, 1].bar(spending_data.index, spending_data.values, color=colors)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Total Spending Across Product Categories', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Product Category', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Total Amount Spent', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Purchase channels comparison
purchase_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
purchase_data = df[purchase_cols].mean()
purchase_data.index = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store']
axes[1, 0].pie(purchase_data.values, labels=purchase_data.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
               colors=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1'], startangle=90)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Average Purchases by Channel', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Customer demographics heatmap
demo_data = df[['Kidhome', 'Teenhome', 'Income', 'Recency']].corr()
sns.heatmap(demo_data, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', center=0, 
            square=True, linewidths=1, cbar_kws={'label': 'Correlation'}, ax=axes[1, 1])
axes[1, 1].set_title('Customer Demographics Correlation Heatmap', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
